headline: Three security deposit hearings between tenants and landlords for 106 Birch Court, 73 Buell Street Apt. 1, and 54B Intervale Avenue.
summary: The board will hold three hearings on security deposit disputes between tenants and landlords for properties on Birch Court, Buell Street, and Intervale Avenue.
items: Hearing: Kyla Rathbone (tenant) vs. Ertan Barucic (landlord), security deposit case re: 106 Birch Court
Hearing: Jonah Cather-Walter and Jonas Tenzer (tenants) vs. Gardner Properties LLC c/o Neil Gardner (landlord), security deposit case re: 73 Buell Street Apt. 1
Hearing: Lana Peters (tenant) vs. MR Dupont Real Estate, LLC c/o Daniel Hogan (landlord), security deposit case re: 54B Intervale Avenue
location: Front Conference Room, 645 Pine Street, Burlington, VT 05401
